_comment: This file contains NAVIGATION ONLY. It holds no answers and no advice - every
id below points at a record that already exists in data/qa.json, which stays
the single source of truth and is edited through /admin.
A step is only defined where the existing records genuinely support it. TC has
22 records that fall naturally into three stages, so TC has a second step. The
other categories do not have enough records to split without producing branches
that lead to one or two answers, so they have no second step rather than a
Any record not listed here is never hidden: it still appears under its category
and in search. Adding a new Q&A in /admin therefore needs no change here.
TC stages were read off the questions themselves:
before  - what to prepare, deadlines, which documents, whether to apply yet
filling - working inside the portal form
after   - submitted, returned for revision, issued, or needing a correction
